recent.quoted_text: Steph Curry left after 6 minutes tonight, saying he tweaked something in his abdominal area. Left the arena in the second half to get an MRI. Steve Kerr noted that he’s never injured that area before. “Concern is high but I have no extent of the injury,” Kerr said.

recent.text: Will Richard said Steph Curry talked to his Warriors teammates at halftime and assured them he’d be good before heading for MRI in second half.
